$comment: The source of sf-chart-sankey (standard simai.smart-component 1.3.14 in the 1.4 form, vocabulary 1.1.5). The parameters are docs/research/catalogue.md of ui-chart (Sankey) and the flow shape of docs/research/parameters.md §2.1, the keyboard docs/research/rendering.md §3.1, the renderer D5, the name and the form docs/DECISIONS.md D14 (the owner's choice of the chart, the form by the recommendation under the owner's delegation, 2026-11-05).

label.summary: What the chart shows, in a few words: its accessible name and the table's caption. Required in practice: without it the chart is named «График».

items.summary: The data: a list of records, one per flow ([{source, target, value}, …]), or an object of columns. The same pair named twice is one flow with the sum. A row without a source, a target or a positive value, or from a node to itself, is left out; a flow that would close a loop is left out too, because the diagram runs one way; the summary says how many.

colors.summary: The colours of the nodes by name ({Бюджет: 'primary'}): a Framework role, which follows the theme, or any CSS colour or variable; anything else is dropped with a console report, as is a colour under 3:1 against the background (drawn all the same). A node without one takes the chart colour of its place, in the order the rows first name it; a band takes its source's colour, light.

source.summary: The field of the flows' sources; source when unset.

target.summary: The field of the flows' targets; target when unset.

value.summary: The field of the flows' amounts, positive; the first numeric field other than the source and the target when unset.

labels.summary: auto writes a node's name and value beside it, after it or, in the last column, before it, cut with an ellipsis to the room between the columns, when the node and its gap are a line high. none leaves them to the tooltip, the live line and the table.

tooltip.summary: flow: under the pointer or the cursor, a node's name with what comes in and what goes out, or a band's source and target, its value and its share of the source.

y-format.summary: The values' format: number, integer, decimal-<n>, compact, currency-<CODE> or unit-<unit>, in the page's language. Shares are always percent.

size.summary: The rung of the size ladder: the plot's height, the text and the gaps. 1/2 for a card, 2 for a page of its own.

table.summary: The same data as a table: toggle offers a button that swaps the plot for it, visible shows it under the plot, hidden keeps it for screen readers only. Never none: the table is the chart's text.

summary.summary: auto: a sentence of what the data does (the nodes, the flows, the stages and the total that flows in, the largest flow with its share of the source, the node where the most arrives), said before the plot. The description slot adds the host's own words.

data-state.summary: auto: ready with flows, empty without. loading draws the frame without marks; error offers «Повторить», which sends refresh.

select.summary: The person chose a node: a click on it, or Enter or Space on the keyboard cursor. index is its place in the order the rows first name it, node its name, value the larger of what comes in and what goes out, in and out those two.

refresh.summary: The person asked for the data again from the error state; the host loads it and sets items.

description.$comment: The host's own words about the chart: said with the summary (aria-describedby) and shown under the plot.

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16); the plot is SVG (D5): a Sankey diagram has a node and a band per flow, a few hundred at most.

skeleton.$comment: The items arrive after the first paint when the host loads them: the derived skeleton holds the plot's box (its height is the size rung's) until they do (standard 1.3.8 §5.4).

accessibility.x-keys: The plot is one Tab stop (role group, aria-roledescription «диаграмма потоков»). Up and Down move the cursor from node to node within a column; Right goes along the node's largest outgoing flow to the next column and Left along its largest incoming flow back, or to the nearest node there when it has none that way; Home and End go to the first and the last node, column after column. Each move is said in a polite live region: the node's name and value, what comes in from where and what goes out to where, the three largest each way. Enter and Space choose the node (select); Escape takes the cursor away. The table button is a button of its own.

x-summary: A Sankey diagram: quantities flowing between stages or categories, the nodes in columns by their longest path from where the flows start, a band from node to node as wide as its flow, a node in a chart colour and its bands in the light fill of it, names and values beside the nodes where they fit, a tooltip for a node or a band, a keyboard cursor over the nodes along the largest flows, a summary in words, and every flow as a row of a table.
x-decisions: name: sf-chart-sankey, the catalogue's name, the Framework's naming rule sf-[set]-<block>[-<variant>], block chart, as the charts of M2 (docs/DECISIONS.md D14), family chart. Reserved by the dispatcher (ui-control 4a70440).

data: the flow shape of parameters.md §2.1, source, target and value fields; the same pair named twice is one flow with the sum; a row without a positive flow, or from a node to itself, is left out and counted; a flow that would close a loop is left out and counted, because the diagram runs one way.

layout: own implementation in chart-core/sankey; a node's column is its longest path from a node nothing flows into, a node that flows nowhere stands in the last column; one scale for every column, each centred; the order in a column sorted a few times by the weighted middle of the joined nodes, so the bands cross less.
colours: a node takes the chart colour of its place (--sf-chart-1..8) and its outgoing bands the colour's light fill; colors by node name for a page's own.

labels: a node's name and value beside it, before it in the last column, cut with an ellipsis to the room between the columns; a node too thin for a line stays without, its words are in the tooltip, the live line and the table.
renderer: own SVG (D5); a Sankey diagram reads a few hundred flows at most, so there is no canvas layer.
keyboard: the cursor is on the nodes; Up and Down within a column, Left and Right along the largest flow; a node is said with its flows in and out. A band is reached by the pointer and the table.
table: never none; one row per flow with its source, target, value and share of the source.
loops, flows that skip back, nodes placed by hand and drill-down: not in 0.1.0.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-chart-sankey to show how quantities flow between stages or categories: a budget split into its uses, traffic sources into pages and outcomes, energy from sources to consumers.
do_not: Do not draw a chart without a label
Do not use it for stage counts only; a sf-chart-funnel shows them
Do not use it for flows with loops: the diagram runs one way and leaves them out

accessibility.focus: One Tab stop on the plot, then the table button. The summary is the plot's description; each cursor move is said politely.

$comment: The chart draws its empty and error states as sf-empty-state; a tag it renders is a tag it fetches.
Its own button (the table toggle) is a native button, so it fetches no sf-button.
